aboutDetails: M. Phil in Clinical Psychology Institute of Psychiatry, SSKM HOSPITAL (IOP- COE)
Currently attached with Calcutta National Medical College
Former Clinical Psychologist of NIMHANS, Bangalore
gettingHelpText: As a clinical psychologist, I’m here to offer my expertise and support to help you navigate difficult times. If you’re struggling with anxiety, low self-esteem, depression, anger management, or stress, don’t hesitate to reach out. I’m here to provide a safe and confidential space where you can freely express yourself and work toward a more fulfilling life.

quotes.text: The good life is a process, not a state of being. It is a direction, not a destination.
quotes.author: Carl Rogers

quotes.text: Love and work... work and love, that's all there is.
quotes.author: Sigmund Freud

quotes.text: If you deliberately plan on being less than you are capable of being, then I warn you that you'll be unhappy for the rest of your life.
quotes.author: Abraham Maslow

quotes.text: The aim of Positive Psychology is to catalyze a change in psychology from a preoccupation only with repairing the worst things in life to also building the best qualities in life.
quotes.author: Martin Seligman

quotes.text: Probably the biggest insight... is that happiness is not just a place but also a process. ... Happiness is an ongoing process of fresh challenges, and... it takes the right attitudes and activities to continue to be happy.
quotes.author: Ed Diener
